evidence_items.explanation: Both models performed strongly in this code-editing evaluation, with their ordering changing by prompting setup. This supports usefulness and comparability in one domain, but does not establish broad equivalence or factual reliability.

evidence_items.locator: Abstract; model identification in Appendix A.3.2 of the paper
evidence_items.explanation: The medical tests support factual unreliability for Gemini Pro. They also found weaker performance than GPT-4 on important medical tasks, cautioning against a blanket comparability claim; they do not establish Ultra’s reliability.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved independent evidence does not establish both parts of the forecast across a sufficiently broad set of matched tasks.
Ultra’s coding results and Pro’s medical reliability results cannot simply be combined into a decisive finding about one model.
The claim supplies no capability tolerance or factual-reliability threshold.
